list.title: Tasks
list.description: Browse historical evaluation tasks with model and dataset info.
list.apiNotReadyTitle: Task list endpoint pending on backend
list.apiNotReadyDescription: Once the backend implements GET /eval/tasks, history will render here. For now, submit a new evaluation and follow the detail page.
list.empty: No evaluation tasks yet. Click "New evaluation" to start.

detail.title: Task detail
detail.cancelConfirmContent: Stop this evaluation? Partial artifacts will be kept, but no further inference will run.

submit.title: Submit evaluation
submit.description: Configure model, dataset and runtime parameters, then create the evaluation task.

task.name: Task name
task.namePlaceholder: Optional. Used to search and identify; if empty, only the short task ID is shown.

model.kindLocalTip: Requires loading local weights and logits. Coming soon.
model.sourceHint: API models only show compatible datasets (typically GEN). PPL-style datasets that need logits will be available once local model support ships.
model.presetEmptyDescription: Add a preset under "Models", or switch to manual entry.
model.modelNamePlaceholder: The "model" value sent to the API, e.g. qwen-plus / gpt-4o-mini
model.versionPlaceholder: Optional. Distinguish runs of the same model.
model.apiKeyPlaceholder: Used only for this run, can be saved.
model.saveAsPresetHint: When on, the entry is saved under "Models" for next time.

dataset.selectPlaceholder: Pick a dataset compatible with the chosen model source
dataset.emptyAll: No enabled datasets. Sync or enable some under "Datasets" first.
dataset.emptyApi: No API-compatible (GEN) datasets available. Check inference mode under Datasets, or sync built-ins.
dataset.incompatibleTitle: Dataset incompatible with the selected model source
dataset.incompatibleDescription: This dataset uses PPL (perplexity) inference, which requires direct logits access and only works with local models. Please pick a GEN dataset, or wait until "Local model" ships.
dataset.incompatibleSkip: Dataset incompatible with the selected API model source; prefill skipped.

empty.title: No metrics yet
empty.noMatch: No metrics match the filter, please adjust.
empty.wait: Metrics will appear after the task succeeds.

empty.title: No artifacts yet
empty.description: Once the task finishes, the report, raw results and log paths will appear here.

artifacts.tip: All artifacts live under {dir} on the server. "Preview" shows up to 512KB of text; use "Download" for larger files.

preview.truncated: Content exceeds 512KB and is truncated. Download for the full file.
preview.binary: Binary file is not previewable, please download.

log.emptyDescription: Once the task starts, OpenCompass main log will be written and shown here.
